A Synacktiv-authored fortress built around a Symfony app that leaks its whole soul through a dev profiler. The walkthrough below is AES-encrypted in the page. Paste any one of the three flags to unseal it.

<div class="jet-gate">
  <h3>unseal</h3>
  <p class="lead">Paste any Synacktiv flag. Any of the three decrypts the writeup, in your browser, with the flag as the key.</p>
  <div class="jet-row">
    <input id="syn-flag" type="text" placeholder="paste a SYNACKTIV{...} flag" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false">
    <button id="syn-go">unseal</button>
  </div>
  <div id="syn-status"></div>
</div>
<div id="syn-body"></div>
<script type="text/plain" id="syn-b0"></script>
<script type="text/plain" id="syn-b1"></script>
<script type="text/plain" id="syn-b2"></script>
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/crypto-js/4.2.0/crypto-js.min.js"></script>
<script>
(function(){
  var blobs=[]; for(var i=0;i<3;i++){var e=document.getElementById("syn-b"+i);blobs.push(e?e.textContent.trim():"");}
  var inp=document.getElementById("syn-flag"),btn=document.getElementById("syn-go"),st=document.getElementById("syn-status"),host=document.getElementById("syn-body");
  function dec(b,k){try{var w=CryptoJS.AES.decrypt(b,k);var t=w.toString(CryptoJS.enc.Utf8);return t||null;}catch(e){return null;}}
  function go(){
    var f=(inp.value||"").trim();
    var cands=[f, f.replace(/\}$/,"").replace(/^SYNACKTIV\{/i,"SYNACKTIV{"), "SYNACKTIV{"+f.replace(/^SYNACKTIV\{/i,"").replace(/\}$/,"")+"}"];
    for(var c=0;c<cands.length;c++){for(var i=0;i<3;i++){var t=dec(blobs[i],cands[c]);if(t&&t.indexOf("OK::")===0){host.innerHTML=t.slice(4);st.className="jet-ok";st.textContent="[+] flag accepted. writeup unsealed.";window.scrollTo({top:host.offsetTop-40,behavior:"smooth"});return;}}}
    st.className="jet-bad";st.textContent="[-] not a Synacktiv flag.";
  }
  btn.addEventListener("click",go);
  inp.addEventListener("keydown",function(e){if(e.key==="Enter")go();});
})();
</script>
